title: Anhui Key-Nano New Material Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Anhui Key-Nano New Material Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese advanced materials company active in carbon-neutral and thermal-safety technologies. The company integrates research, production, and sales of aerogel new materials and related thermal-protection products for building, industrial, battery, and electronics applications.

Company Overview

Key-Nano highlights aerogel industrialization, inorganic fire-protection materials for battery thermal runaway scenarios, and broad product development backed by patent activity and university-linked R&D. Its public materials describe a multi-base operating footprint spanning Hefei, Dingyuan, and additional research/business sites.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China with industrial partnerships across automotive, building, and energy sectors.
  • Focus Areas: Thermal safety, carbon-neutral materials, EV battery protection, building insulation, and electronics-related aerogel applications.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel powder and dispersions
  • Aerogel thermal insulation film
  • Aerogel insulation cotton and blankets
  • Aerogel thermal slurry and coatings
  • Aerogel blocks and fire-protection materials
  • Public Capacity: The company states it operates more than 40,000 sqm of office, R&D, and production space; a specific annual aerogel output figure is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed public pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Sites: Hefei headquarters and Dingyuan production base, Anhui, China.
  • International Certifications: Specific international certificates are not clearly listed on the reviewed pages.
  • Official Website: https://www.key-nano.com/
